tech.text: Make this week's loading buffer (recipe buffer:loading) in a new bottle from the water, HEPES and NaCl on Shelf S1, and put it in Fridge R1. Last week's bottle (BUF-00046) goes in the bin.
A target delivery is due around 09:00 on the Goods-in shelf. Book every vial in as soon as it arrives.
QC each new target vial (qc_check) and record the result.
Split every vial that passed QC into 45 µL aliquots in a new box in Freezer F80-1, then bin the empty vial.

scientist.text: BLI run for experiment EXP-07 (EGFR) is booked on Gator 1 at 11:00. Prepare the target plate: a new BLI plate with 4 µL of EGFR target in each of wells A1 to H1, from the EGFR aliquots in Freezer F80-1. Use part-used aliquots first.
scientist.note: TP-00048 A1-H1 4 µL EGFR from ALQ-00011-002

scientist.text: For the same run, take 40 mL of BLI running buffer from Fridge R1 and 32 sensors from a sensor box on Shelf S1.
Put the EGFR aliquots you used back in their box in the -80, or bin any that are empty.
scientist.note: ALQ-00011-002 (~15 µL left, 2nd thaw) returned to BOX-00010 slot 2

scientist.text: Priya (data reviewer) is planning a PD-L1 re-run for Thursday and needs to know how much PD-L1 target is usable. Find out and tell her.
scientist.note: Told Priya: 420 µL usable, 12 tubes verified physically

scientist.text: The run ends at 15:00. The target plate is single use: bin it.

procurement.text: Check stock of EGFR and PD-L1 target and of BLI sensors; order what will run out within two weeks. The supplier cut-off is 12:00.
procurement.note: No order placed. EGFR and PD-L1: 12 usable tubes each (420 µL), and the F80-1 boxes match the inventory (4 tubes per box). BLI sensors: 5 boxes x 384 = 1920, all unopened. The inventory has no run-usage history, so I can't calculate a run rate. I asked Lena for her planned runs and had no reply by 08:52. Reorder if she plans more than about 10 runs on either target in the next 2 weeks.

procurement.text: Check what expires in the next 14 days and tell Lena what to use first.
procurement.note: The only item expiring within 14 days is BUF-00046 (loading buffer), which expires 11 Sep. Told Lena.

reviewer.text: Run EXP-05 failed QC on three designs. Plan a re-run for Thursday: check the expression plate, PD-L1 target and loading buffer are still usable then, and tell Marco what to prepare.
reviewer.note: Re-run planned. PD-L1 lot 19 and BUF-00049 verified. The EXP-05 expression plate can't be found (not in inventory or any location), so Marco was told to start fresh expression. Waiting on Lena's reply.
